description: Canonical dependency-direction manifest for PandaLog. Read and enforced by tests/architecture/dependency-direction.test.ts. A package MUST NOT import from a package not listed in its 'allowedDependencies'. A package MUST NOT import 'node:*' modules unless 'platformNeutral' is false.

layers.responsibility: Canonical flight data model: types, enums, validity/unit definitions. No behavior, no I/O.
Unit conversion tables, time base normalization, signal/dataset construction, validity propagation rules.
Parser adapter contract, adapter registry, canonicalization bridge from raw source records to the canonical model.
ArduPilot DataFlash (.bin/.log) binary decoding, FMT/message-table handling, adapter implementation for the ingestion contract.
Signal query engine: selection, resampling, alignment across TimeBases, derived-signal registry and evaluation.
Flight event detection engine operating on canonical datasets and derived signals.
Deterministic analysis rule engine; produces evidence-backed findings and hypotheses from events/signals.
Requirement definitions and deterministic requirement evaluator (PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE/NOT_APPLICABLE).
Headless command-line execution of ingestion, analysis, verification, and report generation.
Vue application: investigation workspace, plots, map/3D, comparison, report preview. Consumes application services only.
Cross-flight and flight-vs-baseline comparison of signals, events, findings, and verification outcomes.
Renders structured analysis/verification/comparison artifacts into reproducible report documents. Performs no calculation.
Context builder over evidence + LLM client wrapper. Explains/summarizes/hypothesizes; never overrides deterministic results.

rules: A package may only import from packages listed in its own allowedDependencies.
A package with platformNeutral=true must not import any 'node:*' builtin or any package whose package.json declares Node-only APIs.
No package may import from apps/web. Application code depends on packages; packages never depend on the application.
A layer number expresses a partial order only; packages sharing a layer number have no dependency relationship between them unless explicitly listed.
